Label: Purpose
Is Replaced By: To point to the record(s) that replace the withdrawn one.

Label: Entry Guidelines
Is Replaced By: Enter the ID of each replacement record.

Label: Commentary
Is Replaced By: Mirrors [Is Replaced By](../ogm-aardvark/#is-replaced-by) (`dct_isReplacedBy_sm`). If you are keeping the old record published, use that field on the record instead of withdrawing it.
